notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 regional interaction services to the exact official C++ RTIambassador declarations exported by the Requirements Lab. It verifies regional declaration state, committed region context, active/passive per-(interaction-class, region) state, overlap-filtered no-time interaction sends, callback rechecks, and the official RegionHandleSet callback marker. The focused filesystem-report case additionally verifies the successful §9.10/§9.11 file records with type-27 InteractionClassHandle, type-43 RegionHandleSet, and the type-6 passive-indicator Boolean, including stable serial order and switch gating; this is not public MOM-interaction or conformance evidence. The direct-source Relaxed DDM case additionally proves the documented exact-boundary overlap expansion; broader policy matrices remain open. A passive regional subscription remains declaration and region-lifecycle state but cannot arrange a Receive Interaction callback; re-subscribing the same pair changes its active/passive mode. It does not claim object-instance regional registration/association, object-class attribute regional services, Request Attribute Value Update With Regions, timestamped/retraction behavior, save/restore, remote transport, package support, catalog evidence, or conformance.
